sentences.en: As they grow, spiderlings build increasingly larger webs at ever greater heights, until they reach maturity and construct their trademark two-foot diameter web between tree limbs, tall grasses or other suitably elevated, sunny location.

sentences.en: Dance Dance Revolution uses a two-foot by two-foot pad that's placed on the ground.
